Single Storey U-Shaped Kindergarten IFC

This task starts from scratch with no init_file inputs and no local reference images. Create a Revit U-shaped kindergarten around an open play yard and save the required output in the Desktop as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc, and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc is at least 500 bytes.
2. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
4. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcProject, 1 IfcSite, 1 IfcBuilding, 1 IfcBuildingStorey, 7 IfcSpace entities, 8 IfcWall entities, 1 IfcSlab, and 1 IfcRoof.
5. The IFC model contains at least 3 IfcDoor entities and at least 8 IfcWindow entities.
6. The IFC model contains 0 IfcBuildingElementProxy, 0 IfcStair, 0 IfcColumn, and 0 IfcBeam entities.
7. The normalized IfcSpace name list contains the tokens lobby, classroom a, classroom b, nap, dining, teacher, and toilet at least once each.
8. The shaped IFC product bounding-box X span is between 26.0 m and 30.0 m.
9. The shaped IFC product bounding-box Y span is between 22.0 m and 26.0 m.
10. The shaped IFC product bounding-box Z span is between 3.0 m and 4.2 m.
11. The single IfcSlab horizontal projected footprint area divided by the bounding-box rectangle area is between 0.68 and 0.82.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
